newsitem.title: USA: Santa Fe Energy to convert preferred.
newsitem.headline: Santa Fe Energy to convert preferred.

text.p: Santa Fe Energy Resources Inc said Tuesday it intends to mandatorily convert its convertible preferred stock, seven percent series, issuing 2,280,000 common shares for the approximately 1,230,000 preferred shares outstanding.

Upon conversion of the preferred, the company said, it will incur a non-cash reduction to earnings available to common stock of $7.5 million to $9.0 million, depending on the price of the Santa Fe common at that time.

Santa Fe Energy said it intends to give formal notice on May 27 to holders of the seven percent preferred of its election to mandatorily convert each preferred share into 1.8519 shares of Santa Fe common.

The company also said the dividend of $0.35 per share previously declared payable on June 2 to holders of record on May 1 will be paid on May 27. Further, it said it has declared a special dividend of $0.222 per share of seven percent preferred to cover all accrued and unpaid amounts through the conversion date, payable on May 27 to holders of record on May 16. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
